HD.HD-04: John, do you like holiday celebrations with family?
Yes, I enjoy holidays and parties with my friends.
What is your favorite festival or special event?
I like Christmas because of lights and fireworks.
Do you usually go to parties on your birthday?
Yes, I have a birthday party with cake and balloons.
What kind of music do you like at celebration events?
I like to listen to dance music and sing happy songs.
Do you wear special dress or costume for festivals?
Sometimes I wear a costume for Halloween parties.
What food and drink do you enjoy at parties?
I enjoy cake, snacks, and cold drinks during events.
Do you take many photos or videos at celebrations?
Yes, I use my camera to take photos and videos.
Who do you invite to your holiday or festival parties?
I invite family, friends, and sometimes my neighbors.
How do you decorate your home for special celebrations?
We use balloons, lights, and colorful decorations.
What is the tradition for New Year in your family?
We watch fireworks and wish each other good luck.
Do you like to give or receive gifts at holidays?
I like both giving and receiving gifts with thanks.
How do you prepare a gift bag or present for friends?
I wrap gifts carefully and add a card with wishes.
Do you remember your last holiday party's special date?
Yes, it was on December 25th, Christmas day.
What do you usually do during Easter celebrations?
We enjoy egg hunts, special food, and family time.
Have you ever attended a wedding party or celebration?
Yes, I went to my cousin’s wedding last year.
Do you like to dance or sing songs at holiday events?
I like to dance with friends and sing fun songs.
How do children enjoy holidays and festivals?
Children love balloons, cake, gifts, and playing games.
What makes a party fun and happy for everyone?
Good music, delicious food, and smiling faces help.
Do you like to watch Christmas or New Year videos?
Yes, videos of fireworks and celebrations are great.
What is the best surprise you had at a holiday party?
My friends gave me a big cake and many gifts once.
How do you feel during family celebrations?
I feel very happy and love spending time with family.
Do you send greeting cards or messages for holidays?
Yes, I write cards and send messages to close friends.
What foods do you eat during festival celebrations?
We eat cakes, snacks, and drink juice or soft drinks.
Do you think traditions are important for holidays?
Yes, traditions help us remember and enjoy holidays.
What season do you like for holiday celebrations?
I like winter holidays with snow and warm parties.

HD.HD-04: John, do you use a computer or a laptop daily?
Yes, I use my laptop to work and watch videos.
What kind of software or program do you like?
I like music apps and games on my computer.
Do you use your phone or tablet more often?
I use my phone to call, text, and check emails.
How do you connect your devices to the internet?
I use wifi at home and at work for internet.
What is your username and password for websites?
I keep my password secret but share my username.
Do you like to watch TV or listen to the radio?
I listen to music on the radio and watch TV shows.
What device do you use to control your TV?
I use a remote to change the channel or volume.
Do you use a keyboard and mouse with your computer?
Yes, I type with the keyboard and click mouse.
How often do you charge your phone or tablet?
I charge my phone every night with a charger.
Do you use a cable or plug to connect your devices?
Yes, I use a cable and plug to charge devices.
What do you do when your device battery is low?
I find a charger and connect it to the device.
Do you like to download or upload files online?
I often download music and upload photos online.
How do you open or close apps on your tablet?
I open apps by tapping and close them by swiping.
Do you play video games on your computer or phone?
Yes, I play games on both my phone and laptop.
What do you do if your screen is too dark or bright?
I press the light button to adjust the screen.
Do you watch videos or listen to songs online?
I like to watch funny videos and listen to songs.
What folders do you use to save your files?
I save photos in one folder and work files in another.
How do you search for information on the internet?
I type keywords and open websites to search info.
Have you ever used a camera on your phone?
Yes, I take photos and videos with my phone’s camera.
Do you use the speaker on your phone or computer?
Yes, I use speakers to listen to music and videos.
Do you type messages or call more often?
I type messages often but also make quick calls.
What button do you press to start your computer?
I press the power button to start the machine.
Have you seen a robot or used robot software?
Yes, I use some robot apps for fun and work.
How do you keep your wifi safe at home?
I use a strong password to protect the wifi.
What do you do if your internet is not working?
I restart the router or call the internet provider.
